verdict.rationale: Square provides a Payouts API (List Payouts) and dashboard-level cash flow management, giving a starting point for reconciling payouts, but there is no evidence of itemized fee breakdowns, transaction-to-payout matching reports, or a dedicated reconciliation report tool. missing for 10: itemized fee reporting API/docs, dashboard reconciliation report walkthrough, independent/hands-on confirmation of reconciling takings vs payouts.
